39031.rationale: Scope: this adjudication contains ALL 30 unique packet assignments, ten per seed, b011 through b020; no packet records are omitted. This is the original independent auditor's recheck, not a fresh independent context. Original reviews-v2/packet-12.json is preserved unchanged (SHA256 ca59f7b775090d1f22b9d7bf1e5a2af2c6d8b86f80d558d383b81aed2c412eda). I read the complete frozen rubric and 75 query-spec rows and re-read actual packet fields and my own review. The added exact-query context resolves b011 x01/x05 and b012 x04/x10: RUN-X120-LACE differs from requested RUN-X120 and RUN-X120-SOLE, while TRAIL-X121 differs from requested RUN-X121 and TRAIL-X120. Full SKU/component evidence, not declared contrast names, is decisive. All identity scalars now contain actual catalogue model/edition strings only; title and role interpretation remain in rationale and quoted evidence. All original contexts/facts and literal measurement evidence are retained; no negated or absent variable was promoted to measured. Compared with both other seeds, this seed preserves the ten products, documented processes, basis distinctions, measurement types and full identifiers; acceptance/endurance titles remain intentionally fixed. Wording meaningfully varies narrative structure, paragraphing, order, length and placement of measured variables between description/distributions. b011 has dimensions/edition/month; b012 only carton dimensions/cost; b013/b014/b019/b020 have sound/distance/flow; b015 has sound/distance only; b016 sound only; b017/b018 dimensions/edition/month. Distribution formats/content associations checked: b011 CSV/PDF/PDF, b012 CSV/PDF/PDF, b013 CSV/PDF/CSV, b014 CSV/PDF/CSV, b015 CSV/PDF, b016 CSV/PDF, b017 CSV/PDF/PDF, b018 CSV/PDF/PDF, b019 CSV/PDF/CSV, b020 CSV/PDF. Each synopsis repeats the record's own columns and explicitly describes comma-separated downloads or PDF tables consistently with the format. Numerical examples, fictional locations and publishers differ across seeds: preservation means core claims/types, not identical numerical observations. Publisher/spatial text supplies context only; no temporal field is projected. The newly read f01 paraphrases all concern observed complete running-footwear traction on wet paved surfaces; none asks for a lace or a commercial ledger. The f02 paraphrases all concern indoor hydraulic-circulation sound testing; none asks for a non-operating interface specification. The frozen success criteria state the same three measured facts for each respective group; query wording does not itself enumerate every required fact. No corpus-wide paraphrase, coverage, no-answer absence or ranking conclusion is claimed. No actual field supports either frozen no-answer conjunction or contains answer-key labels. Final v3 source references/hashes are supplied by the parent, whose assertion of unchanged b011-b020 metadata is the basis for carrying this actual v2 packet evidence to v3; I did not inspect full v3 corpora or independently hash them. Format checks are metadata-level, not downloaded-file checks.

Newly read f01 and f02 paraphrases preserve the corresponding wet-pavement-footwear and indoor-hydraulic-acoustic needs; the explicit success criteria, not bare synonyms, supply all required columns. No unresolved record-level issue remains from this recheck; packet-wide coverage of absent targets and all-corpus no-answer absence are outside scope.
